$comment: Faces the asset commands draw with: static instances of the two Google Fonts families named in tokens.css (SIL Open Font License; the licenses sit beside them). display is --ds-font-display (Chakra Petch, light and regular), mono is --ds-font-mono (Kode Mono). Satoshi (--ds-font-sans) is not shipped: its Fontshare license does not cover redistributing the files, so assets set their few lines of running text in Chakra Petch, as the brand's own social tool (agd-playground hoplite-og) does.
